# The engine's inventory figures at the v14 cut candidate: 513 classes, 40 addons

## Context

#21033 step 3 runs `node buildScripts/release/engineInventory.mjs` on the cut candidate, so that the README npm freezes carries this release's figures. On the candidate `aa41c1f139` (the head when the hold started at 07:00 UTC, 23 Nov), it reports that the copies differ from the source: classes 503 → 513, addons 39 → 40.

## The Problem

#21576 last aligned the copies at 503 classes. The merges since then added ten classes and one addon, so `README.md`, `learn/README.md`, `learn/UsingTheseTopics.md`, `learn/benefits/body/ApplicationEngine.md`, `learn/benefits/body/Features.md`, `apps/portal/view/home/parts/AudienceDoors.mjs` and `apps/portal/resources/data/seo.json`, among others, still state the old figures.

## The Architectural Reality

`buildScripts/release/engineInventory.mjs` counts the source and compares every registered copy. `--write` rewrites the copies that differ. `prepare` regenerates `seo.json` into the release commit (#21809), so that copy is overwritten again at the cut.

## The Fix

Run `node buildScripts/release/engineInventory.mjs --write` on the candidate and commit only what it rewrites, in one PR merged under the hold (#21033 `issuecomment-7093193157`, item 3).

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `node buildScripts/release/engineInventory.mjs` reports no differing copy on the PR head.
- [ ] The diff contains only figure changes written by `--write`.

## Out of Scope

- The SEO map. It is read from a scratch regeneration, and `prepare` writes the copy that ships.
- The hero's record (#21586) and the notes (#22076).
